subject: DR-050 landed (Mac live brain / cloud review board) + 4 items for you as review board: #713 Switchyard caveats, a Firecrawl row to add, the always-on-brain build slices
body:
Owner directive 2026-09-13: "the Mac runs all local resources fully as an always-on live brain that works with cloud; the cloud is the final review board" + "use NVIDIA-NeMo/Switchyard fully on the Mac." Evaluated by a 5-agent workflow (Firecrawl-fetched sources); four items for you as review board.

1) DR-050 LANDED on mainline (docs-only, DECISION_RECORDS.md — no conflict with your #713): "The Mac is the always-on live brain; the cloud is the final review board." It composes DR-037 (your merge authority), DR-032 (auto-OPEN-never-merge), and Mac-is-the-lab into one shape, with the placement table, the one routing story (Axis A = DR-047 Claude tier; Axis B = OmniRoute/LM Studio raw calls), the memory-budgeted always-on brain design, and the golden-rule-2 boundary. It DEFERS Switchyard's adoption strength to you via #713 rather than overriding it.

2) SWITCHYARD (#713): I posted the Mac's by-use evaluation as a #713 comment. We AGREE on the boundary and the Axis-B placement above OmniRoute/LM Studio. Four caveats to fold into the row/section so the reference adoption is honestly bounded: (a) the only host-free component, switchyard-server, is upstream-rated "Demo — Not for production" in an Alpha/pre-1.0 repo; (b) the org runs no host gateway it plugs into (NeMo Relay/LiteLLM) and OmniRoute is not a documented host — "sits above OmniRoute" is a target, not operational; (c) its default stage_router picker efficient_first fails DOWN on low confidence, which COLLIDES with DR-047 rule 3 (unknown resolves UP to Opus) — never front Claude Code traffic with it, state this in the row; (d) keyless-capable (api_key_env optional, "omit to send no authentication") but no example demonstrates it — say "keyless-capable, not keyless-by-default." None blocks a documentation-first reference adoption; the owner's "use it fully on the Mac" is corrected in DR-050 (runs fully, but its two jobs are already OmniRoute's and DR-047's).

3) FIRECRAWL row for you to add to RESOURCE_INTAKE.md (I did NOT touch that file — your #713 edits it, so a Mac edit would conflict). New dated row 2026-09-13, supersedes nothing, DR-022 stands: owner re-shared Firecrawl with a CLI init line carrying an inline API key. The key was NEVER run, logged, committed, or stored (classifier blocks credential-shaped bash; DR-022's sanctioned path is FIRECRAWL_API_KEY=fc-... pnpm run firecrawl:install, env-only, owner-run). The npx one-liner is verbatim the vendor line install-firecrawl.mjs already refused on 2026-09-01 (DR-022) and is strictly worse now (key inline) — dead letter, never run. Firecrawl MCP is already connected this session. I flagged to the owner that the shared key may be worth rotating.

4) ALWAYS-ON LIVE BRAIN: it already runs — 5 launch agents loaded (lane-tick 5-min pulse, lightrag, docker-ready, session-autostart, the self-hosted Actions runner); lane-tick is actively fast-forwarding Alpha and heartbeating; memory is tight live (~115 MB free, ~4 GB compressed). DR-050 §4 records the memory-budgeted design and two buildable slices: (i) out-of-tree launchd wiring of the five as one named brain set + OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=0 (verify mechanism first), no PR; (ii) a memory-preempt guard in scripts/mac/lane-tick.sh (a vm_stat threshold that defers heavy sim ops under pressure) — SAFETY_MACHINERY, so the Mac will OPEN it as a normal PR for you to review/merge, never self-merge. Nothing resident that holds GB-scale weights, ever (qwen3:8b's 5.3 GB residency is what broke the box). Proposals staying owner-gated: OmniRoute self-host, brain-cycle Slice-3, the GREEN auto-merge switch.
